title: Thin Sheets
text: Thin Sheets. Great, absolutely great for summer in Florida. Not so great for fall and worse in winter. These are thin. Thin enough to read through and I bought the black. They're very soft and feel nice against the skin. They seem to wrinkle very little. I had heavier jersey sheets the past few years which are the reverse of these. They were way too warm in the summer. These solve that problem. Overall I'm pleased with the purchase.
